subject: Linguistics
title: Writing and AI
description: A fast breakdown of Writing and AI for builders.

hook.text: AI can now generate human-like text, read handwriting, and translate between scripts in real time.

buildup.text: OCR (optical character recognition) can digitize ancient manuscripts that humans struggle to read.

discovery.text: Neural networks have been applied to undeciphered scripts—searching for patterns humans might miss.

twist.text: AI-generated text raises new questions: who is the 'author' when a machine produces the writing?

climax.text: Technology is transforming writing from a purely human act into a human-machine collaboration.

punchline.text: Writing was humanity's first technology—AI may be its next chapter.

quiz.question: How is AI being applied to ancient scripts?
options: Searching for patterns in undeciphered writing
